ai_summary_zh: 【AI 3D 幾何與地面實景照片多模態判釋】本測區（QiHu — Unified Merged Scan (4 Scans)）經 TWD97 局部地形視窗裸地 DTM 分離、3D 法向量/UV 光譜與 11 張行動裝置 RTK 實景照片投影驗證：共識別出道路鋪面 3 處（平面面積 2,518.9 m²）、喬木 42 株（1.3m 胸高斷面 Pratt 圓擬合平均胸徑 DBH 23.4 cm）、水域與未建模水面空洞 2 處（面積 1,726.0 m²，靜水岸際基準高程 TWVD2001 +6.82 m）、以及垂直擋土牆/護岸結構 38 段（3D 垂直立面面積 891.7 m²）。
ai_summary_en: [Gemini Vision + 3D Geometry & Ground Photo Referee] Multi-scale local DTM, 3D surface normal/UV analysis, and 11 calibrated mobile phone photo projection(s) on 'QiHu — Unified Merged Scan (4 Scans)' verified 3 paved road corridor(s) (2,518.9 m² planar), 42 canopy tree(s) (mean 1.3m breast-height DBH 23.4 cm via anti-webbing Pratt circle fit), 2 water basin / un-modelled canal void zone(s) (1,726.0 m² at hydrostatic shoreline TWVD2001 +6.82 m), and 38 retaining/structural wall segment(s) (891.7 m² true 3D vertical face area).
